program.title: A Dialectic Analysis of the Perfection of Wisdom
program.subtitle: String of White Lotuses (PAD MA DKAR PO’I PHRENG BA) · a dialectical analysis (MTHA’ DPYOD) of the Perfection of Wisdom.
